slides.say: Some logic should run once when the app loads, like checking an auth token.
In an Effect, it runs twice in development. If check auth token was not built for that, it might invalidate the token.
Track it with a top level variable. Now it runs once per app load, not once per mount.

slides.text: Or run it at module level, before render. Keep that to App.js or the entry point.
slides.say: You can also run it at the top of the module, before the app renders. Do not overuse that: keep it in the root module or entry point.
